profile_text.body:
Meta is a public company founded in 2004 and headquartered in Menlo Park, California, trading under the ticker META. Its developer site, llama.com, presents Meta's AI models and tools for developers, including access to Muse Spark through Muse Code and the Meta Model API. The site describes Muse Spark as tuned for long-horizon coding workflows, and says it performs competitively with frontier models across several coding evals. It also describes search grounding, which gives a model live web access through a single tool added to a request, and Muse Image, a reasoning model that plans layout before drawing, offered on the Meta Model API at $0.01/image. Muse Glimmer is described as an open-weight model built for local agents. The site says an existing OpenAI SDK compatible client can be pointed at the Meta Model API, with a first working request in under five minutes.

The product tracked here is Llama (Meta), an open-weight model family that is often self-hosted. Meta's most recent revenue filing is a 10-K for the period ending 2025-12-31, reporting $200,966,000,000.

Meta faces several lawsuits in this record: State of New Mexico ex rel. Torrez v. Meta Platforms, Inc. in the First Judicial District Court, Santa Fe County, New Mexico; Neural AI, LLC v. Meta Platforms, Inc. in the District Court for the Western District of Texas; Chicken Soup for the Soul, LLC v. Meta Platforms Inc. in the District Court for the Northern District of California; and Kadrey v. Meta Platforms, Inc. in the U.S. District Court for the Northern District of California. California is listed with a law exposure count of 281. A number of MCP servers relate to Meta advertising and related tools, including ai.adweave/meta-ads-mcp, described as a Meta Ads MCP server with 47 tools for campaigns, creatives, audiences, and insights, co.pipeboard/meta-ads-mcp for Facebook and Meta Ads automation, and com.adbloop/meta-ads for bulk-creating Facebook and Instagram ads across accounts from Drive folders.
